title: First attempt to address screen printing-induced degradation in copper-plated heterojunction solar cells
summary: Researchers in China have investigated a previously overlooked degradation mechanism in copper-plated heterojunction solar cells caused by screen-printed photoresist. They found that progressive wear of the screen mesh can damage the cells' passivation layers and reduce efficiency. An optimized emulsion buffer layer reportedly prevented the degradation over 40,000 consecutive printing cycles.
